study type: In vitro and animal model study
cohort: The study utilized two trophoblast cell models (primary human trophoblasts and forskolin-induced BeWo cells) and pregnant CD-1 mice.
finding: 27-hydroxycholesterol inhibits trophoblast cell fusion by activating the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway, leading to decreased fetal weight, placental efficiency, and inhibited fetal blood vessel development in pregnant mice.
